entries.name: RAMP_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The client ID of a Ramp developer app made for KaratOS. It goes only to Ramp.
howToGet: In Ramp, open Company > Developer, create an app named KaratOS, add the client credentials grant type, and give it the transactions:read scope only, with no write scope.
Copy the client ID straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: RAMP_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: The client secret of the same Ramp app. With the client ID it gets a token that can read card transactions only; the connector turns down a token granted any other scope. It goes only to Ramp.
howToGet: Ramp shows the secret when the app is created. Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: RAMP_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: Optional. production for the business's Ramp account, or sandbox for a Ramp sandbox. Defaults to production.
howToGet: Leave it unset for the business's own Ramp account.
